```{r}
library(lubridate)
library(tidyverse)
library(terra)
library(dplyr)
library(here)
source(here("01_functions","functions.R"))

# for correlation analyses
library(car)
library(GGally)

```

# RONI index

```{r}
# Read into a tiblle
csv <- read_csv(here("00_data", "raw", "roni.csv"))

colnames(csv)

roni <- csv |>
  rename(
    date = 1,
    roni = 2
  ) |>
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date),
    roni = na_if(roni, -9999)
  )|> 
  filter(
    date >= as.Date("2020-10-01"), 
    date < as.Date("2024-11-01")
  )
  

roni

ggplot(roni, aes(date,roni))+
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_date(
    date_labels = "%b %Y",
    date_breaks = "3 months",
    date_minor_breaks = "1 month"
    ) + 
    annotate("rect", xmin = as.Date("2023-07-01"), xmax = as.Date("2024-02-01"), ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,         alpha = .2
    ) +
    annotate("text", x = as.Date("2024-07-01"), y = 1.5, label = "El Niño"
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Date", 
      y = "Relative Oceanic Niño Index (°C)") +
    theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, hjust=1)) 
  

#----------------------------------
# filter rone above 0.5
roni_05 <- roni |>
  filter(roni >=0.5)
```

# Climate data

```{r}
# ERA 5 Tair at 2m at 13:30 and 01:30 solar time
temp <- read_csv(here("00_data","processed", "t2m_1330_0130_solar_time.csv"))
temp

# Total Precipitation - monthly mean
precip <- read_csv(here("00_data","processed", "monthly_total_precip.csv"))
precip

# Surface short-wave (solar) radiation downwards at 13:30 solar time (ssrd taken for the hour before)
ssrd <- read_csv(here("00_data","processed", "ssrd_1330_solar_time.csv"))
ssrd

```

# LST data

```{r}
monthly_lst <- read_csv(
  here("00_data", "processed", "lst_cooling_monthly_mean.csv"),
  col_types = cols(
  solar_time = col_character(),
  .default = col_guess()
  ))

monthly_lst$month_date <- as.Date(monthly_lst$month_date, format = "%m/%d/%Y")

monthly_lst

```

# Join RONI and Climate data and LST

```{r}
# join with the roni table
full <- roni |>
  full_join(temp, by = "date") |>
  full_join(monthly_lst, by = join_by("date" == "month_date")) |>
  full_join(precip, by = "date") |>
  full_join(ssrd, by = "date")

full

write_csv(full, here("04_output", "lst_and_climate_var_monthly_mean.csv"))
```

## Plot join

```{r}

full <- read_csv(
  here("04_output", "lst_and_climate_var_monthly_mean.csv"),
  col_types = cols(
  solar_time = col_character(),
  .default = col_guess()
  ))

# First restructure the data
df_long <- full |>
  filter(solar_time == "13:30") |>
  # select(c(precipitation_mm, roni, ssrd_Wm2_1330, t1330, lst_mean, cooling)) |>
  pivot_longer(
    # cols = c(precipitation_mm, roni, ssrd_Wm2_1330, t1330, lst_mean, cooling),
    cols = c(precipitation_mm, roni, ssrd_Wm2_1330, t1330, lst_mean, cooling),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  )

df_long

# Factor the variables, to define the order they will appear in the plot
df_long$variable <- factor(
  df_long$variable,
  # levels = c("precipitation_mm", "roni", "ssrd_Wm2_1330", "t1330", "lst_mean", "cooling")
  levels = c("precipitation_mm", "roni", "ssrd_Wm2_1330", "t1330", "lst_mean", "cooling")
)

# Change the names for the plot
df_long$variable <- dplyr::recode(df_long$variable,
                           # t1330 = "Air Temperature (°C)", #at 13:30 local solar time
                           t1330 = "Air Temperature (°C)", #at 01:30 local solar time
                           roni = "Relative Oceanic Niño Index (°C)",
                           precipitation_mm = "Precipitation (mm)",
                           lst_mean = "Land Surface Temperature (°C)", #at 13:30 local solar time
                           ssrd_Wm2_1330 = "Downward short-wave solar radiation (W m⁻²)", #at 13:30 local solar time
                        
                           cooling = "Forest-induced cooling (°C)")


# Then plot with facet wrap
ggplot(df_long, aes(date, value)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  scale_x_date(
    date_labels = "%b %Y",
    date_breaks = "3 months",
    date_minor_breaks = "1 month"
    ) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = as.Date("2023-07-01"), xmax = as.Date("2024-03-01"), ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, alpha = .2
    ) +
    theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, hjust=1)) +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1)
```

## Corellation

```{r}
df <- read_csv(here("04_output", "lst_and_climate_var_monthly_mean.csv"))

#renaming the columns for readability
# names(df)[names(df) == "cooling"] <- "forest_cooling"
names(df)[names(df) == "lst_mean"] <- "lst"
names(df)[names(df) == "t1330"] <- "air_temp"
names(df)[names(df) == "precipitation_mm"] <- "precipitation"
names(df)[names(df) == "ssrd_Wm2_1330"] <- "solar_radiation"

# Create a group variable
df$period <- ifelse(df$date >= "2023-03-01" & df$date <= "2024-04-30",
                    "El Niño period",
                    "Other months")

ggpairs(
  df,
  columns = c("air_temp",
              "solar_radiation",
              "precipitation",
              "lst",
              "cooling"),
  diag = list(
    continuous = wrap("densityDiag", alpha = 0.4)
  ),
  upper = list(
    continuous = wrap("cor", size = 3)
  ),
  aes(color = period, shape = period),
  progress = FALSE
)

# check for lst of open land and lst of forest
ggpairs(
  df,
  columns = c("air_temp",
              "solar_radiation",
              "precipitation",
              "forest",
              "open_land",
              "cooling"),
  diag = list(
    continuous = wrap("densityDiag", alpha = 0.4)
  ),
  upper = list(
    continuous = wrap("cor", size = 3)
  ),
  aes(color = period, shape = period),
  progress = FALSE
)


```

```{r}
df <- read_csv(here("04_output", "lst_and_climate_var_monthly_mean.csv"))


# Create a group variable
df$period <- ifelse(df$date >= "2023-03-01" & df$date <= "2024-04-30",
                    "El Niño period",
                    "Other months")

df_13 <- df |>
  dplyr::rename(
    `Air temperature (°C)` = t1330,
    `Solar radiation (W m⁻²)` = ssrd_Wm2_1330,
    `Precipitation (mm)` = precipitation_mm,
    `Forest LST (°C)` = forest_1330,
    `Open-land LST (°C)` = open_land_1330,
    `Forest cooling (°C)` = cooling_1330
  )

df_01 <- df |>
  dplyr::rename(
    `Air temperature (°C)` = t0130,
    # `Solar radiation (W m⁻²)` = ssrd_Wm2_0130,
    `Precipitation (mm)` = precipitation_mm,
    `Forest LST (°C)` = forest_0130,
    `Open-land LST (°C)` = open_land_0130,
    `Forest cooling (°C)` = cooling_0130
  )

cor_panel <- function(data, mapping, ...) {
  
  x <- eval_data_col(data, mapping$x)
  y <- eval_data_col(data, mapping$y)
  
  r <- cor(x, y, use = "complete.obs")
  
  fit <- lm(y ~ x)
  slope <- coef(fit)[2]
  
  # Use 3 decimals for small slopes, otherwise 2
  slope_label <- if (abs(slope) < 0.01) {
    sprintf("%.3f", slope)
  } else {
    sprintf("%.2f", slope)
  }
  
  ggplot(data = data, mapping = mapping) +
    
    # ONE regression line using all observations
    geom_smooth(
      aes(group = 1),
      method = "lm",
      se = FALSE,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.5,
       alpha = 0.3
    ) +
    geom_point(size = 1.5) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = mean(range(x, na.rm = TRUE)),
      y = Inf,
      label = paste0(
        "r = ", sprintf("%.2f", r),
        "; b = ", slope_label
      ),
      hjust = 0.5,
      vjust = 1.5,
      size = 3.5
    )
}



# daytime
p <- ggduo(
  df_13,
  columnsX = c(
    "Air temperature (°C)",
    "Solar radiation (W m⁻²)",
    "Precipitation (mm)"
  ),
  columnsY = c(
    "Forest LST (°C)",
    "Open-land LST (°C)",
    "Forest cooling (°C)"
  ),
  mapping = aes(color = period, shape = period),
  types = list(
    continuous = cor_panel
  ),
  progress = FALSE
)

# Same y-axis for forest and open_land
for (i in 1:2) {
  for (j in 1:3) {
    p[i, j] <- p[i, j] + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(22.5, 40))
  }
}

for (i in 3) {
  for (j in 1:3) {
    p[i, j] <- p[i, j] + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 17.5))
  }
}

p

# nighttime
p2 <- ggduo(
  df_01,
  columnsX = c(
    "Air temperature (°C)",
    "Precipitation (mm)"
  ),
  columnsY = c(
    "Forest LST (°C)",
    "Open-land LST (°C)",
    "Forest cooling (°C)"
  ),
  mapping = aes(color = period, shape = period),
  types = list(
    continuous = cor_panel
  ),
  progress = FALSE
)

# Same y-axis for forest and open_land
for (i in 1:2) {
  for (j in 1:2) {
    p2[i, j] <- p2[i, j] + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(12, 23))
  }
}

for (i in 3) {
  for (j in 1:2) {
    p2[i, j] <- p2[i, j] + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 11))
  }
}

p2
```

## Linear T-air and T-lst

```{r}
ggplot(df, aes(x = lst, y = air_temp)) +
  geom_point() +
  stat_poly_line(formula = y ~ x, color="red", se=FALSE) +
  stat_poly_eq(use_label("eq", "R2"), formula = y ~ x) +
  labs(
      x = "Land surface temperature (°C)",
      y = "Air temperature (°C)"
    )+
  theme_minimal() 
```

## Hottest months

```{r}
full <- read_csv(here("04_output", "lst_and_climate_var_monthly_mean.csv"))

# print the hottest months for open land according to the lst data
hottest <- full |>
  group_by(year)

hottest |> slice_max(t1330, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) #results 03, 02, 02, 03

hottest |> slice_max(lst_mean, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) #results 04, 03, 04, 03

hottest |> slice_max(ssrd_Wm2_1330, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) #results 03, 03, 04, 03

hottest |> slice_max(cooling, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) #results 04, 04, 03, 04

hottest |> slice_min(precipitation_mm, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) #results 03, 01, 02, 01

full |>
  filter(
    year == 2021 & month == 12
  ) |> select (precipitation_mm)

hottest |> 
  arrange(precipitation_mm) |>
  slice_head(n=3) |>
  select(date, precipitation_mm) |>
  filter(year != 2020)
  
```

## older Corellation

```{r}
df <- read_csv(here("04_output", "lst_and_climate_var_monthly_mean.csv"))

pairs(df[, c("cooling",
             "lst_mean",
             "t1330",
             "precipitation_mm",
             "ssrd_Wm2_1330")])

cor(df[, c("cooling",
           "lst_mean",
           "t1330",
           "precipitation_mm",
           "ssrd_Wm2_1330")],
    use = "complete.obs")
```

```{r}

# standardize predictors
df <- df |>
  mutate(
    temp_z = scale(t1330),
    precip_z = scale(precipitation_mm),
    radiation_z = scale(ssrd_Wm2_1330)
  )

pairs(df[, c("cooling",
             "lst_mean",
             "t1330",
             "precipitation_mm",
             "ssrd_Wm2_1330")])

cor(df[, c("cooling",
           "lst_mean",
           "t1330",
           "precipitation_mm",
           "ssrd_Wm2_1330")],
    use = "complete.obs")
```

```{r}

model_full <- lm(
  cooling ~ temp_z + precip_z + radiation_z,
  data = df
)

summary(model_full)
```

```{r}

vif(model_full)

```
